Let  
\[
|\psi\rangle=\frac12|\uparrow\rangle+\frac{\sqrt3}{2}|\downarrow\rangle.
\]

Using \(\sigma_z=\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\0&-1\end{pmatrix}\) and \(\sigma_x=\begin{pmatrix}0&1\\1&0\end{pmatrix}\),

\[
\langle\sigma_z\rangle=\left|\frac12\right|^2-\left|\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\right|^2
=-\frac12,
\]

\[
\langle\sigma_x\rangle=2\left(\frac12\right)\left(\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\right)
=\frac{\sqrt3}{2}.
\]

Therefore,
\[
\langle10\sigma_z+5\sigma_x\rangle
=10\left(-\frac12\right)+5\left(\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\right)
=-5+\frac{5\sqrt3}{2}\approx-0.67,
\]
which is \(-0.7\) to one decimal place.

Answer: A
